body:
I assume it's fine that we're no longer going through a `JPH::InternalEdgeRemovingCollector` when `JoltProjectSettings::use_enhanced_internal_edge_removal_for_queries` is enabled, since we don't actually care about individual contact points in `intersect_shape`?

(In hindsight I'm not sure if it was a good idea to carry this setting over in the first place, but here we are.)

Yes. It is actually better to not use internal edge removal here. Consider the following scene where 2 boxes are attached to the same rigid body: The edge between the red and the blue box will be considered an internal edge. When intersecting the red sphere, contact 2 is ignored because it hits an internal edge. This means `intersect_shape` will incorrectly report only contact 1 and thus only return the shape id for the red box.
